decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's core dumper expertise and retained a dedicated webpage in 2024, indicating sufficient absorptive capacity to keep improving it.
Similar to A, the articulated dumper leverages existing construction machinery knowledge and stable web presence, so the firm can interpret early results and continue investing.

The underground mine rescue vehicle appears less related to the firm's core construction and mining machinery knowledge, and its reduced web presence in 2024 signals difficulty in assimilating and improving this niche product.
The compact telescopic loader draws on established loader capabilities and maintained its own webpage, supporting ongoing learning and product refinement.
Although launched in 2024, the material lift benefits from the firm's existing knowledge in this category, as evidenced by the Paus Easy 18's sustained rental demand and large orders.
The compact underground mining loader shows strong early utilization (1,000 hours in 7 months) and aligns with the firm's mining equipment expertise, facilitating learning and improvement.
